verifications.claim: Spectrum SportsNet LA is the home for most Dodgers games in the local market.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "More than 145 regular-season games land on the Dodgers’ regional sports network, or RSN. Spectrum SportsNet LA is the team’s TV home when it isn’t on the national marquee."
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states Spectrum SportsNet LA is the TV home for most regular-season games (over 145) not on national TV, in the local market.

verifications.claim: Fubo, YouTube TV, and Hulu + Live TV offer access to local and national Dodgers games.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: "You can watch MLB games live on Fubo"; R2: "live-streaming services that carry the channels above, including YouTube TV, Sling TV, Hulu + Live TV and fuboTV." (for FOX World Series games)
verifications.reasoning: References support access to national Dodgers games (e.g., World Series on FOX, general MLB via Fubo), but do not confirm carriage of local RSN Spectrum SportsNet LA, which R1 notes is limited to few providers.

verifications.claim: MLB.TV allows streaming of Dodgers games not televised in the local area.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: "Out-of-market fans... all out-of-market Dodgers diehards need MLB.TV to watch the regional SportsNet LA games." "in-market Dodgers fans cannot use MLB.TV to stream SNLA broadcasts."; R4/R7: MLB.TV for specific out-of-market streams.
verifications.reasoning: R1 explicitly states MLB.TV is for out-of-market (non-local) viewers to stream Dodgers RSN games, with blackouts for local market.

verifications.claim: Dodgers games are occasionally on MLB Network, FOX, or ESPN.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: "MLB Network... usually airs a couple of games each week." "Fox/FS1... more than 85 regular-season games"; "ESPN... 30 regular-season exclusives"; R4/R7: Specific Dodgers games on MLB Network.
verifications.reasoning: R1 details occasional Dodgers broadcasts on MLB Network (weekly), FOX/FS1 (many but not all), and ESPN (30 games), matching 'occasionally'.

verifications.claim: The MLB App offers in-market streaming for authorized subscribers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "SNLA+ provides 24/7 digital access to all SportsNet LA programming through the MLB app and MLB.com. This service, which is only available to fans in the Dodgers’ home territory"
verifications.reasoning: R6 confirms MLB App streams SNLA+ (Dodgers games) for in-market (home territory) authorized subscribers.

verifications.claim: Spectrum subscribers can stream Dodgers games via the MLB app
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Spectrum TV customers with a package that includes SportsNet LA will have access to SNLA+ on the MLB app and MLB.com."
verifications.reasoning: R6 directly states Spectrum TV customers (subscribers) with SportsNet LA access SNLA+ (Dodgers games) via MLB app.
